mission.body: Each mission presents an extract from an actual CAG audit report in English. Your task is to translate it into Hindi while maintaining accuracy, clarity, terminology and the prescribed reporting structure.

objectives.title: Submit
objectives.body: Submit a clear, professionally structured translation.

mission.briefBody: Deliver Hindi that matches the standard of CAG's own published reports.
briefPoints: Three chances per level; your best score counts
Numbers, years and rupee amounts stay exactly as they are

score.passMark: Score {n} or above to earn the level title.

criteria.translation: How close your Hindi is to CAG's published standard.
criteria.completion: How much of the page you translated.
criteria.sentence: Grammar, full stops and clean Hindi sentences.
criteria.glossary: Approved Hindi terms used for audit vocabulary.
criteria.time: Finish with time to spare for the best score.

score.creditsNote: Higher scores earn more of each level's credits. A weaker later attempt never reduces them.

toolkit.romanBody: Type Hindi words using English letters. BHASHINI converts them into Hindi script as you type.
romanSteps: Pick a suggestion with Space or 1–4
toolkit.glossaryBody: Find approved Hindi equivalents of commonly used administrative and audit terminology to maintain consistency throughout your translation.
toolkit.glossarySearch: Search a term, for example audit
toolkit.glossaryNone: No matching term found. Try a simpler word.
toolkit.glossaryInGame: In the game, glossary terms are underlined in the workbench. Click one to see its approved Hindi options.
toolkit.voiceBody: Speak in Hindi and watch your words appear in the editor. Review and correct them by keyboard.
toolkit.rightHeading: Pick the tool that suits you
toolkit.rightRoman: Fast and works on every device. The default way to write Hindi in a mission.
toolkit.rightGlossary: Use it any time you are unsure of a term. It is the same list the scorer uses.
toolkit.rightVoice: Hands-free drafting for the Trial. From Level 2 you type every word.

coach.dialogue: Hello! I'm Sahayak, your guide throughout the challenge. I'm here to help you navigate missions, understand terminology and make the most of your translation toolkit.

rules.fairPlay: Copy-paste is disabled during a mission. Leaving the page is counted on your report card.
rules.agree: I have understood the game instructions and agree to proceed.
